A scavenger tug hauls a salvaged hull-plate away through the field, dwarfed to a speck beneath the broken ships.
A survey probe drifts silently through the graveyard, its antenna blinking once, a needle threading a canyon of dead steel.
A lone fighter on patrol weaves between the broken hulls, running-lights tiny as fireflies against the cold wreckage.
A salvager in a cutting suit burns through a hull-seam, the torch-glow a single bright point on the dead ship's flank.
A drone swarm picks methodically at a fractured cruiser, each unit a gnat against the vast corroded superstructure.
A tug strains forward hauling a salvaged section of bridge tower, both vessel and cargo lost beneath the surrounding wrecks.
A single EVA engineer floats motionless beside a dead engine bell, utterly swallowed by its scale, her lamp barely reaching the rim.
A courier skiff skims low along a shattered keel, dwarfed to insignificance by the row of dead battleships flanking it.
A recovery vessel inches forward through the debris field, its floodlights catching tumbling fragments, one warm light in absolute cold dark.
A lone pilot on a thruster-sled crosses the open gap between two wrecked carriers, a dust-mote crossing a cathedral.
A repair drone hovers at the junction of two smashed hulls, its welding arc a brief orange star in the darkness.
A medical shuttle drifts carefully between the wreckage columns, hull-lights blinking softly, searching the silence for survivors among the dead.
A scavenger in a battered suit cuts free a conduit bundle, the sparks a momentary constellation against the vast ruined hull.
A probe tumbles slow end-over-end through an open hangar bay, its sensors scanning, lost inside the dead carrier's belly.
A light salvage skiff nudges a floating hull-section aside with its bumpers, a small hand moving giant debris in silence.
A fighter escort circles the perimeter of the graveyard, tiny running-lights tracing slow loops around the mountain-range of wrecks.
A two-person boarding craft latches onto a dead destroyer's airlock, impossibly small against the warship's corroded flank.
A drone floats alone in the geometric shadow of a shattered gun-turret, scanning, a mote inside something built to kill worlds.

A surveyor in full EVA photographs the dead fleet's outer hull, drifting backwards, the wrecks rising behind her like cliffs.

A lone ship rides anchor at the field's edge, running-lights the only living pulse among the silent broken fleet.
